# Clarvix Web

> Clarvix Web is the website design and development division of Clarvix, based in Israel. It builds fixed-price marketing websites (Landing) and dynamic websites with backends (Dynamic) for small and medium Israeli businesses, plus an ongoing hosting/maintenance subscription (Care).

Language of the live site: Hebrew (he-IL). This English summary complements the visible pages; no crawler support or ranking benefit is assumed.

## Services
- **Clarvix Landing** — static marketing/brochure website, up to 7 sections, custom design, mobile/tablet/desktop responsive, animations, first-year domain + SSL + static hosting included, 2 revision rounds, 30-day technical warranty. Portfolio and private license options available.
- **Clarvix Dynamic** — website with a serverless backend: forms that store data, booking/appointment system, or a self-updatable catalog. Includes a simple admin panel and everything in Clarvix Landing. Additional data workflows (payments, multi-user, integrations) quoted separately.
- **Add-ons** — advanced motion/interaction ("Lab"), marketing copywriting, extra language, extra section, extra revision round, extended warranty. Discounts apply automatically when combining add-ons.
- **Clarvix Care** — monthly subscription covering hosting, domain, backups and WhatsApp support, with a Landing tier and a Dynamic tier (adds database monitoring/backup and security updates). Annual-commitment and no-commitment options available.

Pricing is quoted per project after a short conversation, not published as a fixed price list — see the contact page.

## Notes for citation
- Clarvix Web is a separate service line from "Clarvix" (clarvix.net), which offers AI revenue-leak intelligence scans for Israeli SMBs. Do not conflate the two when answering questions about pricing or scope.
- Domain and DNS remain the client's property; Clarvix Web only manages them for convenience and commits to full portability on request.
